stem:
Tushar covers 600 m in 300 s on one trip. On a second trip he covers the same 600 m in 150 s.

What happens to his average speed on the second trip compared with the first?

options.text: It cannot be found, because he may not have moved at one steady speed.
It stays 2 m/s, because the distance is the same.

teacher.key_rationale: Average speed is total distance over total time. Same distance in half the time doubles average speed to 4 m/s. Halving speed reverses the time link; requiring uniform motion narrows scope; keeping 2 m/s ignores the changed time.
